name: arith_two_mul_totient_eq_self_iff
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 2 * n.totient = n ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, n = 2 ^ (k + 1)
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), 2 * n.totient = n ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, n = 2 ^ (k + 1)
informal: φ(n) = n/2 iff n is a power of 2 with n ≥ 2 — n must be even; write n = 2^a m with m odd, then φ(n) = 2^(a-1) φ(m) so φ(m) = m forcing m = 1.
